concepts.angle: Lab-study headline: in a 90-day test of 7 pods, 6 left live bacteria on the dentures
concepts.based_on: Source winner: VID_DEN32 '6 of 7 pods leave live bacteria' (30d $12.1K, ROAS 2.15, 164 purchases) + DEN81 H3/H1 '6 of 7 pods can't remove bacteria' ($5.7K/1.88, $2.1K/2.79) + VID_DEN105 ($476/3.08). Primary text: 'A 90-day side-by-side lab test of seven leading ultrasonic dental cleaners... six out of seven machines left live bacterial biofilm active on appliances overnight... only system tested that completely cleared subsurface buildup.' Core emotion: shock + distrust (you thought it was clean). Layout reference: Nontoxic Product Reviews 'Braces? Plaque hides around brackets' (teeth whitening, 11d, top 0.8%) (small red 'NEW STUDY' tag, 3-line serif-free stat headline, one plain explanatory sentence, macro photo of a dental model held under a clinic lamp). Angle -> mechanism: Lab-study headline: in a 90-day test of 7 pods, 6 left live bacteria on the dentures; Hero mechanism: biofilm lives in the appliance's tiny scratches and pores that brushing, soaking and tablets can't reach (so it grows back, yellows and smells); 42,000 Hz ultrasonic in one 5-minute cycle reaches it. Core emotion: shock + distrust. One dominant pain: dentures that look clean still carry live bacteria.
concepts.pain_point: dentures that look clean still carry live bacteria
